heading: Need help now?
explainer: Sends an alert to the TravIndi operations desk and your trusted contacts, with your location if your device can share it. You’ll confirm first.

confirm.title: Send an SOS alert?
confirm.description: Only send this if you need help.
confirm.opsDesk: The TravIndi operations desk will see your alert.
confirm.contacts_one: {count} trusted contact will be alerted where TravIndi can reach them. You’ll see each result.
confirm.contacts_other: {count} trusted contacts will be alerted where TravIndi can reach them. You’ll see each result.
confirm.noContacts: You haven’t chosen any trusted contacts for SOS alerts.
confirm.location: Your current location is included if your device shares it within a few seconds.
confirm.noEmergencyServices: Emergency services are not contacted. Call 112 for police, fire or ambulance.
confirm.messageHint: e.g. what’s happening, or where exactly you are

announce.received: TravIndi has received your SOS alert.
announce.savedOffline: Saved on this device. Your alert will send when you reconnect. If you are in danger, call 112.

sending.title: Sending your alert…
sending.detail: It’s already saved on this device, so it won’t be lost if the connection drops.

pending.title: Your alert hasn’t reached TravIndi yet
pending.offline: It will send automatically as soon as you’re back online.
pending.failed: We couldn’t send it. It stays saved on this device while you try again.
pending.callNow: If you’re in danger, call 112 now.

closed.detail: If you still need help, send a new alert or call 112.

active.title: Your SOS alert was received
active.receivedAt: Received at {time}. Keep your phone with you.
active.noLocation: Your device didn’t share a location in time. If you can, send your location in a message or tell someone where you are.
active.cancelDescription: The operations desk will see that you’re safe. Trusted contacts who were alerted won’t be messaged automatically.

channelNote.authority: TravIndi can’t alert emergency services. Call 112 yourself.
channelNote.contactNotSupported: Can’t be reached through TravIndi (SMS isn’t connected). Contact them directly if you can.
channelNote.contactFailed: The alert didn’t reach them. Try contacting them directly.
channelNote.opsDelivered: Your alert is on the operations desk’s screen.

signIn.title: Sign in to send an SOS alert
signIn.description: Calling 112 works without an account. An SOS alert needs your account so we know who needs help.
